note: A fixed daylight scenario. Unreal and Cycles use different light-unit systems; their numerical intensities are independently calibrated, not assumed interchangeable. Baked maps store diffuse radiance divided by albedo; the web lightMap uses a PI conversion and removes duplicate realtime diffuse lighting. View-dependent specular remains realtime.
